items.text: Giants RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. placed on IR with hamstring; Skattebo (also hamstring tweak but OK with bye) primary beneficiary.
items.implication: Skattebo clear lead with bye recovery; handcuff elevated.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%. Dobbins only 21%; Harvey fluky TD. Priority waiver.
items.why: Dominant snap/rush/route shares on return from IR; Payton praise.
items.implication: Lead back emerging; roster/start over committee mates.

items.text: Gibbs almost certainly fine after purposeful slide ankle turn; Campbell confirmed should be good, pain gone quickly. Lions RB1 ppg leader.
items.why: Purposeful non-score slide; checked and cleared postgame.
items.implication: No downgrade; remains elite RB1 vs MIN.

items.text: ETR OUT: Lamar Jackson (high ankle); still Q/pain on cuts for Week 8 per reports, practice key.
items.why: Missed multiple; pain persists on high-intensity moves.
items.implication: Huntley continues short-term; Flowers elevated with Lamar return upside.
items.opportunity: Ravens pass game suppressed without him

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in YPRR despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Excited for Lamar return boost.
items.why: Elite efficiency even with backup QB.
items.implication: Massive ceiling spike with healthy Lamar; WR1 upside.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst runner (dead last YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet RB13 PPR ppg via 9 inside-5 carries + league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.implication: Sustainable fantasy production despite poor rushing metrics; hold/start confidently.
items.conflict: Efficiency data poor vs fantasy output

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 (clear lead), Tank Dell only 6 in limited return, Noel 15 (exited turf toe).
items.implication: Nico locked as WR1; Dell limited role initially.

items.text: ETR weekend summary listed Puka Nacua as GTD/OPTIMISM; Schefter confirmed ACTIVE vs Raiders.
items.why: Feeling better Saturday, no setbacks expected.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage confirmed post-calf concern.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets as primary LAR WR

items.text: ETR listed Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM for weekend; ended inactive with Allen handling ground work.
items.implication: Monitor practice for Week 8; handcuff elevated short-term.

items.text: ETR: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY; Schefter confirmed ACTIVE for MNF and post-game hamstring 'came out great'.
items.why: Expected and cleared; self-reported fine after gutsy effort.
items.implication: No lingering concern heading into Week 8.

items.text: ETR OUT: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks; opened slot/usage for others in PHI.
items.implication: Increased opportunity for remaining PHI pass-catchers; Lemon bet hit.

items.text: ETR IN: Josh Jacobs cleared and active; Berry discusses ROS value post-return.
items.implication: Reclaims lead back role in GB; strong ROS outlook.

items.text: Not talking Bucky Irving enough as workhorse RB; full respect call.
items.implication: Start confidently as RB1/2; hold through ROS.

items.text: Chiefs without Rice: Worthy 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (lead); but never topped 83 rec yds in 37 career games. Ceiling capped.
items.why: Route volume high but historical ceiling low.
items.implication: Flex/WR3 with volume but limited upside while Rice out.
items.conflict: High routes vs low historical ceiling
